chunks.title: Generic Backend + Redis Docker Compose
chunks.content:
Generic Backend + Redis Docker Compose

Compose pattern for a generic backend service with Redis 7. Backend receives REDIS_URL from environment and depends_on redis. Redis uses redis:7 official image and publishes port 6379. REDIS_URL format for this compose: redis://redis:6379.

Decision rules:
- Use when the backend requires Redis for caching, rate limiting, queuing, or session storage
- Set REDIS_URL to redis://redis:6379 to use the compose service name as hostname

Trade-offs:
- No Redis persistence (no appendonly or named volume) — data lost on container restart
- No Redis authentication — add requirepass via command: redis-server --requirepass ... for non-dev environments

Anti-patterns:
- Do not run Redis without authentication in staging or production
- Do not expose port 6379 to external networks
